title: How a Hybrid Car Works in 60 Seconds 🚗🔋 #shorts
description:
The first hybrid car was built around 1900, more than a century before hybrids became common. A hybrid pairs a gasoline engine with an electric motor and a battery, letting the motor start the car, help the engine, and recover energy when you brake. Follow Inside 60 for a new "how it works" explained in 60 seconds.

#hybridcar #howitworks #shorts

steps.label: Hook
steps.text: The first *hybrid car* was built around 1900, over a century before hybrids got popular.

steps.label: Two Hearts
steps.text: A hybrid has two power sources: a *gas engine* and an *electric motor*.

steps.label: Battery
steps.text: A *battery pack* stores electricity and feeds the motor.

steps.label: Low Speed
steps.text: At low speeds the *motor* can drive the car alone, using no fuel at all.

steps.label: Teamwork
steps.text: When you need more power, the *engine* joins in and both push the wheels together.

steps.label: Braking
steps.text: When you brake, the motor becomes a *generator* and charges the battery.

steps.label: Recap
steps.text: Engine plus *electric motor*. Follow Inside 60 for more.
